scope: Screened-subset same-key utility at 128/512 bits; paired pretrained encoders
limitations: Screen-supported identity mapping, not definitive full-bin mapping.
PCA fitted separately per encoder on calibration identities only.
Raw subset baseline differs from official E01A baseline.
Keys, pairs, and split repeats are dependent; summaries are descriptive.
No identity confidence intervals or significance tests in this run.
512-bit PCA retains all 512 components; template payload excludes weights and operators.
No linkage, replay, inversion, or edge-device latency/energy evaluation.
